set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Human ceiling, §5 item 5.

No recall mapping has a second coding, so no task has a human ceiling. Sherlock scenes, FilmFestival recall_scenematched and Friends WhichEvent are each one coding.

Scope:
Who codes, how much time, which corpora, and approval of the human-ceiling ticket's sampling plan.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Coders identified by role (names need not be committed), with a time budget per corpus.
2. Corpora in scope confirmed (Sherlock, FilmFestival, Friends; development participants only).
3. Blinding to the first coding confirmed as a requirement.
4. Target sample sizes approved.

Gate: the owner's decision is recorded verbatim, or faithfully summarized and confirmed by the
owner, as a decision note on this bead.

Size: S (owner).
set.title: OWNER: people and protocol approval for second human codings (human ceiling)
